close_reason: Completed in commit 1d103fb: ported pi-minions as packages/pi-minions with configurable tool-call delegation hints, tests, build config, README, and root extension registration. Full lint/test/typecheck/build passed.
description:
User request: deeply evaluate https://github.com/kalindudc/pi-minions, port its MIT-licensed implementation into this monorepo as packages/pi-minions, carry forward useful fixes from latest main, and restore/customize the createDelegationHint tool-call based harness steering that was removed around commit 77d2ff522c420451ccf768b5c9cf34320fc497c4.

Acceptance criteria:
- New workspace package packages/pi-minions builds with tsdown and pi runtime deps externalized.
- Ported extension exposes pi-minions tools/commands equivalent to upstream latest main where useful.
- Tool-call-count based delegation hint is present, configurable, tested, and injected into harness context at the intended cadence.
- Tests cover delegation hint behavior and key core paths.
- Repo lint, tests, typecheck pass.
- Atomic conventional commit is created for the package.

comments.text:
Implemented in commit 1d103fb.

Research/evaluation notes:
- Upstream latest main is 5e4844d (v0.18.0) after migration to @earendil-works packages and foreground-only minions.
- Commit 77d2ff522c420451ccf768b5c9cf34320fc497c4 removed background minions, queue/interaction/changelog plumbing, and the context-time delegation reminder (`createDelegationHint`) that had been triggered by tool-call counts and complex prompts.
- Port keeps the latest foreground-focused tool surface (`spawn`, batch tasks, list/show/halt, learn_minions, footer/status/observability) while adapting imports back to this repo's @mariozechner pi packages.
- Restored delegation-conscience behavior in `packages/pi-minions/src/delegation.ts` and wired it through `src/index.ts` via `tool_call` counting plus `context` injection.
- Added config under `pi-minions.delegation`: enabled, toolCallThreshold, promptLengthThreshold, hintIntervalMinutes, acknowledgementRequired, complexTaskKeywords, message.

Validation:
- npm run lint
- npm run test
- npm run typecheck
- npm run build
